articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: What Catalysts Are Rewriting The Weir Group (LSE:WEIR) Story Now?. Weir Group’s story has shifted in an interesting way, with bullish analysts now flagging a raised price target of £33.00 per share, while more cautious voices sit closer to £29.00. That spread in targets reflects two different readings of the same setup: one leaning into confidence around execution and Minerals Aftermarket potential, the other focused on recent order patterns and a more limited upside. As this gap in expectations plays out, stay tuned to see how you can track these evolving... Related tickers mentioned: WEGRY, WEIGF.

articles.title: Goldman Forecasts 20% Gains for China Stocks in 2026
articles.mainIdea: Goldman Forecasts 20% Gains for China Stocks in 2026
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Goldman Forecasts 20% Gains for China Stocks in 2026. The MSCI China Index is forecast to climb 20% to 100 by end-2026 from its 2025 close, while the CSI 300 Index is seen rising 12% to 5,200, strategists including Kinger Lau wrote in a note Wednesday. “Our expected equity gains in 2026 are almost entirely earnings-driven,” they said. Profit growth will be “supported by AI, ‘Going Global,’ and anti-involution policy.”
